name: Abbey
source: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income, printed page 32 (PDF page 34), figures in N'000 scaled x1000 to the naira this file stores. Revenue is the printed Total operating income, which is interest income 18,972,247 less interest expense 13,883,736 plus fees and commission 766,874 plus other income 297,541 (FY2025) and 11,954,184 less 8,557,527 plus 207,668 plus 272,063 (FY2024). Operating Profit (EBIT) is Total operating income less Total operating expenses and is tagged derived; the remaining step to Profit Before Tax is the printed net impairment write back of 15,271 (FY2025) and net impairment charge of 84,200 (FY2024), which the fixed label set has no row for: 3,110,152 + 15,271 = 3,125,423 and 1,313,151 - 84,200 = 1,228,951. EPS is the printed basic and diluted figure in kobo (21 and 11), the unit the interim column already used. FY2023 and earlier annual columns are not filled because the five-year summary page prints its columns out of reading order and no audited column could be mapped to a year with certainty. Read 2026-10-19.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
